proof_body:
by
  intro a b
  ext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  rw [Nat.cast_choose ℚ hi']
  have h1 : (i.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast i.factorial_ne_zero
  have h2 : ((n - i).factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (n - i).factorial_ne_zero
  have h3 : (n.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℚ), PowerSeries.mk (fun k => a k / (k.factorial : ℚ)) * PowerSeries.mk (fun k => b k / (k.factorial : ℚ)) = PowerSeries.mk (fun k => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℚ) * a i * b (k - i)) / (k.factorial : ℚ))
